name: National Domestic Violence Hotline
blurb: Talk, text or chat with an advocate, any time.
blurbEs: Habla, escribe o chatea con una persona, a cualquier hora.
notes: Free, confidential 24/7 crisis support, safety planning and referrals by phone, text or live chat; Deaf Hotline videophone 1-855-812-1001.

name: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
blurb: If you're overwhelmed or thinking of suicide.
blurbEs: Si te sientes abrumada o piensas en el suicidio.
notes: Free, confidential 24/7 emotional and suicidal-crisis support by call, text or chat; Spanish available by text and chat.

name: RAINN National Sexual Assault Hotline
blurb: Support after sexual assault, including by a partner.
blurbEs: Apoyo tras una agresión sexual, también de tu pareja.
notes: Free, confidential 24/7 support for survivors of sexual assault, including sexual violence by a partner.

name: love is respect (National Dating Abuse Helpline)
blurb: For young people and dating relationships.
blurbEs: Para jóvenes y relaciones de noviazgo.
notes: Support for young people and anyone worried about dating abuse, by phone, text or live chat.

name: StrongHearts Native Helpline
blurb: For Native American and Alaska Native people.
blurbEs: Para personas nativas americanas y de Alaska.
notes: Free 24/7 culturally specific domestic and sexual violence support for Native American and Alaska Native people.

name: California Partnership to End Domestic Violence – Find Help Directory
blurb: Directory of local help in every county.
blurbEs: Directorio de ayuda local en cada condado.
notes: Statewide coalition with a directory of local DV programs by county; office and referral line, not a crisis line.

name: California Victim Compensation Board (CalVCB)
blurb: Can pay back costs like medical bills or moving.
blurbEs: Puede reembolsar gastos médicos o de mudanza.
notes: State agency that can reimburse crime-related expenses for eligible victims, including DV survivors; not a crisis line.

name: California Safe at Home (Secretary of State)
blurb: A free substitute address to keep yours private.
blurbEs: Una dirección sustituta gratis para proteger la tuya.
notes: Free confidential address program giving DV, stalking and sexual assault survivors a substitute mailing address; enroll through a designated Enrolling Agency.

name: La Casa de las Madres
blurb: SF shelter and crisis line.
blurbEs: Refugio y línea de crisis en SF.
notes: Emergency shelter and 24/7 adult crisis line (teens: 1-877-923-0700); drop-in center (415) 503-0500, Mon–Fri 8:30am–5pm.

name: Asian Women's Shelter
blurb: Shelter and crisis line in many languages.
blurbEs: Refugio y línea de crisis en muchos idiomas.
notes: Multilingual 24-hour crisis line for survivors of DV, human trafficking and FGM/C, plus a Korean Talk Line and an Arab Women's Services Program.

name: Riley Center (St. Vincent de Paul Society of SF)
blurb: SF shelter and longer-term housing.
blurbEs: Refugio en SF y vivienda a más largo plazo.
notes: 24-hour support line; emergency shelter (up to 12 weeks) and transitional housing (up to 24 months).

name: Community United Against Violence (CUAV)
blurb: Support for LGBTQI survivors.
blurbEs: Apoyo para sobrevivientes LGBTQI.
notes: Peer advocacy counseling, safety planning and support groups for LGBTQI survivors; main office line, not 24-hour.

name: Mujeres Unidas y Activas (MUA)
blurb: Peer support for Latina immigrant women.
blurbEs: Apoyo entre compañeras para mujeres latinas inmigrantes.
notes: Peer counseling by state-trained DV and sexual assault counselors for Latina immigrant women (Oakland (510) 261-3398, Mam line (510) 905-9334).

name: Asian Pacific Islander Legal Outreach (APILO)
blurb: Family and immigration legal help.
blurbEs: Ayuda legal familiar y de inmigración.
notes: Family and immigration legal help for DV survivors (Oakland office (510) 251-2846); not a crisis line.

name: A Safe Place
blurb: Oakland shelter and crisis line.
blurbEs: Refugio y línea de crisis en Oakland.
notes: Oakland 24-hour crisis shelter and emergency line, plus counseling and legal services.

name: Family Violence Law Center
blurb: Crisis line, safety planning and free legal help.
blurbEs: Línea de crisis, plan de seguridad y ayuda legal gratis.
notes: 24/7 crisis line for safety planning, referrals and emergency relocation help, plus legal services for DV survivors.

name: SAVE – Safe Alternatives to Violent Environments
blurb: Fremont shelter and crisis line.
blurbEs: Refugio y línea de crisis en Fremont.
notes: Fremont-based 24-hour crisis line, Safe House shelter, counseling and walk-in Empowerment Center.

name: Restorative Pathways (formerly Ruby's Place)
blurb: Shelter and housing help.
blurbEs: Refugio y ayuda con vivienda.
notes: 24/7 support line; shelter, short-term residence and housing assistance for DV and trafficking survivors.

name: Narika
blurb: Help for South Asian survivors.
blurbEs: Ayuda para sobrevivientes del sur de Asia.
notes: Helpline for South Asian and other survivors: case management, emergency safe nights, legal support and transitional housing.

name: Alameda County Family Justice Center
blurb: Oakland walk-in center: advocates and legal help.
blurbEs: Centro en Oakland: apoyo y ayuda legal.
notes: One-stop center in Oakland with navigators, law-enforcement liaison and a legal advice clinic for DV survivors.

name: STAND! For Families Free of Violence
blurb: Contra Costa crisis line and restraining order help.
blurbEs: Línea de crisis y ayuda con órdenes de restricción.
notes: 24/7 hotline advocates, support groups and DV restraining order help by appointment.

name: Contra Costa Family Justice Center
blurb: Walk-in centers with legal help.
blurbEs: Centros sin cita con ayuda legal.
notes: Navigation, trauma recovery and legal help; centers in Concord, Richmond (510) 974-7200, Antioch (925) 281-0970 and Danville (925) 486-0100.

name: Solano Family Justice Center
blurb: Fairfield walk-in center for survivors.
blurbEs: Centro en Fairfield para sobrevivientes.
notes: Fairfield center offering navigation and support for survivors of DV, sexual assault and abuse.

name: CORA – Community Overcoming Relationship Abuse
blurb: San Mateo crisis line, shelter and legal help.
blurbEs: Línea de crisis, refugio y ayuda legal en San Mateo.
notes: 24/7 hotline, safe housing, counseling, LGBTQ+ support and legal services including representation.

name: Legal Aid Society of San Mateo County
blurb: Free legal help, including restraining orders.
blurbEs: Ayuda legal gratis, incluso órdenes de restricción.
notes: Free legal aid with a domestic violence practice area; call to ask about restraining order help. Office line, not a crisis line.

name: Next Door Solutions to Domestic Violence
blurb: San José shelter and crisis line.
blurbEs: Refugio y línea de crisis en San José.
notes: 24/7 hotline, emergency shelter, safety planning and restraining-order support.

name: YWCA Golden Gate Silicon Valley
blurb: Bilingual crisis line and emergency housing.
blurbEs: Línea de crisis bilingüe y vivienda de emergencia.
notes: 24/7 bilingual support line for DV, sexual assault and trafficking survivors, with safety planning and emergency housing screening.

name: AACI Asian Women's Home
blurb: Shelter and crisis line, with language support.
blurbEs: Refugio y línea de crisis, con apoyo de idiomas.
notes: 24/7 DV hotline and shelter; call to ask about language support.

name: Maitri
blurb: Help for South Asian survivors.
blurbEs: Ayuda para sobrevivientes del sur de Asia.
hours: Mon–Fri 9am–3pm; voicemail returned within about a day
notes: Helpline for South Asian survivors: safety planning, peer counseling, restraining-order paperwork help, court accompaniment and housing.

name: Community Solutions
blurb: Crisis line for Gilroy and Morgan Hill.
blurbEs: Línea de crisis para Gilroy y Morgan Hill.
notes: 24-hour crisis line for intimate partner violence, sexual assault and trafficking, serving South Santa Clara County (Gilroy, Morgan Hill).

name: Center for Domestic Peace
blurb: Marin bilingual crisis line and housing.
blurbEs: Línea de crisis bilingüe y vivienda en Marin.
notes: 24-hour bilingual hotline, housing programs, legal system advocacy, therapy and support groups.

name: SafeQuest Solano
blurb: Solano crisis line and safe housing.
blurbEs: Línea de crisis y vivienda segura en Solano.
notes: 24/7 crisis line, safe housing, restraining orders, court accompaniment and counseling.

name: NEWS (Napa Emergency Women's Services)
blurb: Napa crisis line and advocates.
blurbEs: Línea de crisis y apoyo en Napa.
notes: Free, confidential 24/7 help line for Napa County with crisis support, advocacy and youth/family services.

name: YWCA Sonoma County
blurb: Sonoma crisis line and safe house.
blurbEs: Línea de crisis y casa segura en Sonoma.
notes: 24/7 DV hotline, confidential Safe House shelter, court accompaniment and support groups.

name: Family Justice Center Sonoma County
blurb: Santa Rosa walk-in center: legal and immigration help.
blurbEs: Centro en Santa Rosa: ayuda legal y de inmigración.
notes: Walk-in center in Santa Rosa with advocacy, legal and immigration services, safety planning and safe house access.

name: Legal Aid of Sonoma County
blurb: Help with restraining order paperwork.
blurbEs: Ayuda con los papeles de órdenes de restricción.
notes: Helps with restraining order paperwork; call for an appointment.

name: Bay Area Legal Aid (BayLegal)
blurb: Free legal help: restraining orders, custody, immigration.
blurbEs: Ayuda legal gratis: órdenes, custodia, inmigración.
notes: Free legal advice line for qualifying low-income residents: restraining order clinics and representation, custody and VAWA immigration help. Not a crisis line.
